Callout.Name: Cattle on the Road
Callout.Message: Cattle loose on a county road at night.

Script.Line: Twenty of them at least. The fence is down at the bottom.
It is a blind bend. Somebody is going to hit one.
We need lights on that road before we do anything else.

Lines.Approach: They are on the road in the dark and drivers will not see them. That is the emergency.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
